trivial.description: Documentation, comments, formatting, or an isolated low-risk correction.

standard.description: A normal feature, behaviour, configuration, or dependency change.

high-risk.description: Authentication, authorization, secrets, sensitive data, migrations, architecture, production infrastructure, or AI safety.

lite.description: Lightweight evidence for solo and exploratory projects.

regulated.description: Full evidence and review for audit-sensitive work.

rules.R1: Read STATE.md and context.md before significant or resumed work.
rules.R2: Classify the requested change before deciding which gates apply.
rules.R3: Standard and high-risk implementation requires a human-approved change proposal.
rules.R4: High-risk implementation requires accepted blocking ADRs.
rules.R5: When multiple changes are approved, STATE.md must name one Active Change.
rules.R6: Assistants never modify human-only approval fields.
rules.R7: Completion evidence and security review follow the selected profile and change class.
rules.R8: Detailed role, workflow, and security references are loaded only when applicable.
